domain.description: Matches the filename stem, so a file can be found from its content.

description.description: What kind of work this set applies to. Shown by `axis-sync.sh list`.

extends.description: Domains whose axes are inherited. Resolved one level; on a duplicate id the child's entry replaces the parent's, keeping the parent's position.

axes.description: The axes that are live. This is the only key `ids` reads.

id.description: Stable identifier, lowercase ASCII. check-coverage.sh greps the artifact for this exact string, so the artifact's row must carry the id itself.

when.description: Condition that switches the axis on. Empty means it always applies. An unconditional list forces 'not applicable' rows onto unrelated work, and that fatigue is what makes a list stop being read.

ask.description: The question put to the user during the definition stage.

source_hint.description: Where the evidence for this axis usually lives.

added_by.description: The rework or observation that produced this axis. Required — once the list is long this is the only way to tell an axis born of real rework from one that merely sounded thorough.

retired.description: Axes that were dropped. Kept out of `axes` so nothing reading the live list has to filter, and read only by the retrospective before adding an axis — an axis dropped for a reason should not quietly return.
